MIND. [1] [Coc. c.]
Fit of unconsciousness and absence of mind ; urine turbid. θ Morbus Brightii.
   

INNER HEAD. [3] [Coc. c.]
Rush of blood to head and spitting of dark blood. θ Menorrhagia.
Headache in forehead and temples. θ Acute desquamative nephritis.
Pain in head, with aching pain through small of back. θ Menorrhagia.
Pressive headache. θ Catarrh.
Pain in occiput < from mental exertion. θ Tinnitus.
   

HEARING AND EARS. [6] [Coc. c.]
Roaring in ears begins in evening, lasts through night and disturbs sleep.
   

SMELL AND NOSE. [7] [Coc. c.]
Discharge of thick, yellow mucus from nose. θ Catarrh.
   

UPPER FACE. [8] [Coc. c.]
Sallow complexion.
Face deeply red. θ Acute desquamative nephritis.
   

TASTE, SPEECH, TONGUE. [11] [Coc. c.]
Unpleasant, sweetish, metallic taste in mouth.
Sweetish taste. θ Acute desquamative nephritis.
Metallic taste, with accumulation of water in mouth ; constant desire to spit.
   

INNER MOUTH. [12] [Coc. c.]
Great sensitiveness of mouth and fauces, so that rinsing the mouth causes cough and vomiting of thick masses of mucus.
Accumulation of much tasteless saliva in mouth ; constant desire to spit ; salivation.
   

PALATE AND THROAT. [13] [Coc. c.]
Arches of palate very irritable, so that loud speaking or brushing teeth causes cough and vomiting.
Fauces very sensitive.
Throat < in warmth, especially in bed.
   

APPETITE, THIRST. DESIRES, AVERSIONS. [14] [Coc. c.]
Little appetite. θ Acute desquamative nephritis.
Great thirst ; drinks water often and in large quantities. θ Menorrhagia.
Thirst. θ Acute desquamative nephritis.
   

EATING AND DRINKING. [15] [Coc. c.]
Anxiety after eating, from irregular action of heart.
   

HICCOUGH, BELCHING, NAUSEA AND VOMITING. [16] [Coc. c.]
Nausea. θ Menorrhagia.
Hawking of mucus provokes vomiting.
Vomiting : of thick masses of mucus ; and cough produced by loud speaking, rinsing mouth or brushing teeth ; on account of irritability of arches of palate and sensitiveness of mouth and fauces ; with copious expectoration after midnight, caused by a spasmodic cough.
Vomiting of white, bitter tasting froth. θ Menorrhagia.
   

SCROBICULUM AND STOMACH. [17] [Coc. c.]
For three evenings in succession, sickness at stomach, with faintness and vomiting of white, bitter tasting froth. θ Menorrhagia.
   

HYPOCHONDRIA. [18] [Coc. c.]
Burning and drawing in left hypochondrium.
Constant, dull, burning pain in left hypochondrium and pain across loins as if broken, < from lying on affected side, with loss of sexual power.
Pains in left hypochondrium, as from incarcerated flatulence ; the pains extending to left side of back and lumbar vertebræ.
   

ABDOMEN AND LOINS. [19] [Coc. c.]
Weak forcing across lower part of bowels. θ Vaginitis.
Abdomen distended. θ Menorrhagia.
Sharp pains in lower part of abdomen drawing her double, first in right side, then in left θ Menorrhagia.
Insufferable abdominal pains at night. θ Acute desquamative nephritis.
   

URINARY ORGANS. [21] [Coc. c.]
Nephritis with pericarditis.
Acute renal dropsy.
Urging to urinate. θ Acute desquamative nephritis.
Urging to urinate, but can pass no urine until an enormous clot of black blood has passed. θ Menorrhagia.
Urine excoriates ; falls over vulva drop by drop.
Hemorrhage from the kidneys.
Urine dark-colored, with white sediment, an inch deep, over which was a granular layer, half an inch thick, deeply reddened with blood. θ Acute desquamative nephritis.
Urethral tenesmus.
Gravel.
   

MALE SEXUAL ORGANS. [22] [Coc. c.]
Loss of sexual power, with constant, dull, burning pain in left hypochondrium and pains across loins as if broken.
   

FEMALE SEXUAL ORGANS. [23] [Coc. c.]
Hemorrhage from uterus with passage of large clots, which escape when quiet or when getting up to pass water.
Great tenderness and irritation in extreme lower part of vagina, < when urinating ; can walk a long distance but is < after sitting in the house all day. θ Vaginitis.
Sudden cessation of menstrual flow on second day from exposure ; non-appearance of menses for seven weeks, when she was taken with rush of blood to head and spitting of dark blood ; menses lasted but a few hours ; a week later flow returned with pain in head, aching pain through small of back, at times chilliness, then again fever and sweat ; flow continued two weeks, but only in evening after lying down, never when stirring about ; discharge pink. θ Menorrhagia.
Enormous black clots pass from vagina. θ Menorrhagia.
Soreness of vulva ; cannot bear pressure of clothing.
   

VOICE AND LARYNX. TRACHEA AND BRONCHIA. [25] [Coc. c.]
Fatigue of vocal organs, even after speaking without exertion ; the voice becomes rough and hoarse ; respiration somewhat laborious.
Hoarseness.
Sensation as though a lump as large as a walnut was sticking behind larynx, which obliged him to swallow constantly.
Rawness of air passages, which frequently compels him to cough.
Tickling in larynx, very violent, waking him at 11.30 P. M., causing cough with expectoration of much tenacious mucus, for ten minutes.
Scraping sensation in larynx, causing some paroxysms of cough, with expectoration of little balls of mucus.
Scraping and dry feeling in larynx, < towards evening, with hacking cough and hawking. θ Catarrh.
Catarrh of larynx and air passages.
Chronic bronchitis complicated with gravel ; acid diathesis.
Protracted bronchial catarrhs remaining after whooping cough.
   

RESPIRATION. [26] [Coc. c.]
Respiration somewhat laborious, with fatigue of vocal organs.
Difficult breathing ; dyspnœa.
Shortness of breath. θ Catarrh.
   

COUGH. [27] [Coc. c.]
Paroxysms of tickling cough, ending with expectoration of mucus.
Cough < at 6 or 7 in morning, or on first rising, in paroxysms, which do not cease until a quantity of tenacious mucus is raised. θ Whooping cough.
Cough wakes him at 6 A. M., having remissions of a minute ; it is at first dry, clear and barking ; subsequently some thick mucus is detached, and the effort of doing this causes desire to vomit, with excoriated feeling in throat and pressive headache. θ Catarrh.
Cough < when waking, at 6 A. M. clear, dry and barking ; slight expectoration of thick, viscid mucus, < an hour after dinner, 3 P. M., so violent as to cause vomiting and expectoration of a great quantity of thick, viscous and albuminous mucus.
Attacks of barking, tickling cough, particularly night and morning, after coughing awhile, expectoration of a great quantity of mucus, which is like the white of an egg, tough, white or whitish-yellow, can be drawn into threads and has a saltish taste, with nausea and vomiting of food.
Cough most constant in morning, with expectoration of slime and yellowish mucus of a salt taste. θ Catarrh.
Spasmodic cough after midnight causes vomiting with copious expectoration.
Coughing and vomiting follow loud speaking, rinsing of mouth or brushing teeth.
Cough more or less constant, but < when lying or during exercise. θ Catarrh.
Spitting of dark blood. θ Menorrhagia.
Whooping cough, < when first waking.
Catarrhal attacks, which came on early in Fall, upon first change from warm to cold weather, lasting until next Summer when weather again became warm.
Cough of drunkards.
   

INNER CHEST AND LUNGS. [28] [Coc. c.]
Soreness and pain of whole chest, < at superior portion. θ Catarrh.
Sudden pulmonary congestion, with profuse mucous secretion and spasmodic suffocative cough.
Accumulation of mucus in chest, difficult to raise, nearly causing strangulation and vomiting of food.
   

HEART, PULSE AND CIRCULATION. [29] [Coc. c.]
Irregular beating of heart in rapid succession, causing anxiety after eating.
   

NECK AND BACK. [31] [Coc. c.]
Aching pain through small of back. θ Menorrhagia.
Region of kidneys painful to pressure. θ Acute desquamative nephritis.
Pain across loins as if broken, with loss of sexual power.
Fleeting stitches in loins. θ Acute desquamative nephritis.
   

LOWER LIMBS. [33] [Coc. c.]
Pain and stiffness in right leg. θ Menorrhagia.
   

LIMBS IN GENERAL. [34] [Coc. c.]
Pain in limbs. θ Acute desquamative nephritis.
   

NERVES. [36] [Coc. c.]
General lassitude. θ Acute desquamative nephritis.
Hemiplegia with numbness.
Spasms.
   

TEMPERATURE AND WEATHER. [39] [Coc. c.]
Slightest exposure aggravates catarrh severely.
   

FEVER. [40] [Coc. c.]
Chilliness, then again fever and sweat. θ Menorrhagia.
